messages.subject: User friendly shiny wrapper idea
parts:
Hi All,

I'm new here so please let me know if there are any problems with this post.

I sat down a couple weeks ago and wrote a wrapper for auto-generating shiny apps. The original goal was to leverage the power of shiny in a way that a beginner R user (or a lazy advanced user) can interactively tweak plotting parameters. Analogous in purpose (I think) to qplot for ggplot2, this would be a gateway to working with shiny. The apps can be generated from pre-existing scripts with minimal additional coding

I only spent a day on it, so I'm certain that it is very buggy and full of compatibility issues. I just thought I should post it here. It would be great if similar functionality could be incorporated directly into the shiny package.

You can read more about it on the git repository here: https://github.com/cfhammill/friendlyShiny

I'd love to hear any thoughts you all may have on this idea.

Cheers,

Chris
